title: Hoshino Ichika — Smiling Once More〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Don't Let Doubts Hold You Back

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That was a great practice session, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! We've gotten a lot better at playing this song too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We have. And we should be able to do the whole thing tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, let's pack up and make sure we don't leave anything behind.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I almost forgot...
Did you change the way you drum, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Your rhythm was impeccable as usual, but also...
It was easier to follow than before, maybe...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, I thought the same thing too!
It's has a different sort of aura to it now!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Like you know exactly what you want to do.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I felt the same way too. I could really tell that you were enjoying yourself a lot more, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Well... Now that the choir recital is all done,
maybe I feel lighter and more free?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But that's not the only thing, is it?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. The effort you put in towards being able to talk to your classmates more honestly must have helped too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That experience probably gave you a confidence boost, and improved your sound as a result.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... Hehe. I really hope that's true!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sure it is.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Confidence, huh...? Maybe I'll get the same boost if I try to overcome something I'm having trouble with too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then let's actually try it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?
Diner

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We will now start Operation Talent Boost to improve how Ichi plays by helping her to overcome something she's having trouble with!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... Why are you so excited about this, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because I'm helping my dearest childhood friend♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is that all...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Well, as long as Saki's having fun...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright. What are some things Ichi's having trouble with?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It has to be thrill rides or roller coasters. She was so scared that one time we went to Phoenix Wonderland and went on those rides when we were kids.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, I remember that! That really brings back memories!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I remember too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So if she overcomes her fears, we'll be able to go on lots of roller coaster rides... Wait, that's not the point...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: She's supposed to get a confidence boost and get better at playing!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm not sure this will...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Let me see...
Overcoming a fear of roller coasters... Search!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What are you doing, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm trying to find articles that contain tips on overcoming a fear of roller coasters... Oh, here's one! Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Try to imagine how exciting the scenery will be, like the wind in your face or the sense of liberation you can get from screaming loudly...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But... I clung to the safety bar like my life depended on it last time and was too scared to even look up, so that might tough...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, but what if...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We're all kidnapped by some shady organization and you can't save us unless you overcome your fear of roller coasters!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Where did you get that story from?
It sounds like pure fantasy...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Aww... I thought it was a pretty good idea...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Wait! I just thought of a much easier way for you to overcome something you're having trouble with.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: See, right here!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? This place's menu...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Your rice omelet is here!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, that smells so nice! And it looks delicious...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's making me hungry too.
But not Ichika from the looks of it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Because the rice underneath this omelet is full of green peas, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I-I just can't stand green peas...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're trying to overcome something you're having trouble with, remember? If you'd rather do the roller coaster challenge, we'd be all for that too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ugh... I mean...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Come on, Ichi! You can do it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You two just want to have fun at my expense...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What are you talking about?
Anyway, here's your spoon...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks...
Fine. I'll eat it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh... Found them...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You shouldn't be looking for them!
Just eat normally!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
More like they were looking for me.
They stand out from the rice's ketchupy color...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: In that case, I'll feed you so you don't have to look at them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, thank you... I have a feeling you'll put way more green peas than is necessary into my mouth...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Aww... You're good, Ichi.
You saw right through me!
Then... Let's have Hona feed you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, Honami wouldn't do anything funny so...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay, allow me to do the honors.
Ichika, open wide...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Ugh... This texture...
And the taste they leave behind...
They're there... I'm eating them...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Why are you savoring it when you hate them so much?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika, have some water.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you, Honami! Gulp...
Sigh... I was so sure I was going to die...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: From green peas?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This is gonna take a while, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Then why don't we share it instead?
